resources.string: omakey works offline. It sends no typed text anywhere, and includes no analytics or ad SDKs. Your personal dictionary, clipboard history, and theme choices are stored only on this device. One thing uses the network, and only this: downloading language packs, which happens only when you tap \"Get more languages\" and choose one in Settings → Languages. It talks only to omakey\'s GitHub releases, and sends no typed text or other data.
